value.criterion: AC1: pij/role, pij/output and pij/memory validate the right documents and refuse the wrong ones
value.proof: BUILD: fixture documents beside the schemas (a role with an inline packet, a role whose packet references a brief file, a role missing scope, a role missing its standing packet, one output of each kind, one memory note); `ddocs validate --depth 0` on each, with the expected pass or fail recorded in the execution log.

value.criterion: AC2-AC5: the writer's layout, add, refusals and checkout safety
value.proof: BUILD: cargo tests in pij-daemon against a real temporary git repo that has a prime-governance worktree checked out with an uncommitted edit; a fake validator injected through the constructor (P3) for unit cases, plus one test that runs the real ddocs and names its skip when ddocs is absent. `cargo test -p pij-daemon community`.

value.criterion: AC3, AC6: `pij directory add` and batch import end to end
value.proof: EXTEND: crates/cli/tests/skill_verb_coverage.rs and .omp/extensions/pij/core/generation-skill-coverage.test.ts for the new verb; a private daemon run of `pij-rs directory add` and `--batch` against a scratch repo, transcript in assets/evidence/.

value.criterion: AC7: the store pointer and its rebuild
value.proof: BUILD: migration 0031 with a pij-store test; drop the pointer rows, rebuild from the governance branch head, compare row for row. `cargo test -p pij-store`.

value.criterion: AC8: cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property)
value.proof: EXTEND: crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs covers every new launch site. Live fleet before and after deploy: `pij-rs --json ping | jq .data.spawns` read twice 60 s apart, and `just spawn-rate --seconds 20`; expected no change at rest. Per write on a private daemon: spawn counter delta around one `pij directory add` and one 8-role batch.
value.note: Expected cost. Loop, poll, timer, sweep: none. Launches per `directory add`: about 6 (ddocs validate, ddocs build, and about 4 git calls: a status check on the writer's paths, add, commit --only, rev-parse), each by an absolute path resolved once through pij_core::program::launch; ddocs is a node script, so count the node it starts too. A batch costs the same launches once per batch, not per role. Readings record `data.pid` (AC10).

value.proof: `ddocs validate` on PRD, blueprint and roadmap 001 after the state flips; `just rust-check`; `harness checks`; GitHub CI on the exact head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts on that head.

value.criterion: AC10: ping reports the daemon pid
value.proof: EXTEND: a pij-daemon ping test asserts `data.pid` equals the daemon's own process id; the bp-0005 receipts show the same pid on the before and after readings of each pair.
value.note: Cost: none. The pid comes from std::process::id(), no launch.
